DTC P1730 NC Revolution Sensor Circuit Malfunction
(Counter Gear Speed Sensor)
CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION
This sensor detects the rotation speed of the counter gear. By comparing the counter gear speed signal (NC)
and the input turbine speed sensor signal {NT), the ECM detects the shift timing of the gears and appropriate­
ly controls the engine torque and hydraulic pressure in response to various conditions, thus performing
smooth gear shifting.
